latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Sports Highlight skill for fast, automated sports highlight reel creation.
- Supports video upload (MP4, MOV, AVI, MTS, up to 500MB); outputs 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes via cloud GPU processing.
- Handles session management, token acquisition, credits, export, and state tracking through the Nemo Video API.
- Guides users with workflow prompts and shows connection/progress status in chat.
- Includes robust error handling with user-friendly guidance for common issues (file size/type, credits, rate limits).
- Enables easy highlight extraction for coaches, athletes, and content creators without installing any local software.
